statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial rate control therapy
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
CPT code 93247 is for a 30-day continuous ECG monitoring study
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
The insurer is the secondary payer
